title: Liverpool take an unbeaten European record into Villarreal visit
summary: Liverpool host Villarreal at Anfield on Tuesday missing Jeremie Frimpong, Conor Bradley and Dominik Szoboszlai, with the defence the obvious concern. Liverpool have won both European matches this season, including a 6-3 victory at LASK, while Villarreal beat Napoli 3-1 for their first Champions League win in 12 attempts. Manchester City, beaten 4-2 by PSG last week, host an AEK Athens side that lost 3-1 at Shakhtar Donetsk.
